 Three of the five teams with 100% records are in action on Wednesday evening. James Cormack | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Real Madrid begin Wednesday’s slate. | Dennis Agyeman/Europa Press/Getty Images We’ll officially reach the halfway mark of the 2026–27 Champions League league phase once Wednesday’s action concludes, but there’s still so much to enjoy before we get to that point. 
--> We’ll officially reach the halfway mark of the 2026–27 Champions League league phase once Wednesday’s action concludes, but there’s still so much to enjoy before we get to that point. 
 The evening kicks off with a pair of teams that have combined to claim 21 European crowns, both aiming to maintain their perfect starts to the competition. Real Madrid and Liverpool’s productive openings are hardly surprising, but few would‘ve foreshadowed Real Betis avoiding a blemish through three outings on their long-awaited Champions League return.
--> The evening kicks off with a pair of teams that have combined to claim 21 European crowns, both aiming to maintain their perfect starts to the competition. Real Madrid and Liverpool’s productive openings are hardly surprising, but few would‘ve foreshadowed Real Betis avoiding a blemish through three outings on their long-awaited Champions League return.
 Those sitting pretty toward the summit have the luxury of relaxing at this relatively early juncture, and although we’re still almost three months away from the chaotic Matchday 8, those bereft of points as we approach halfway will certainly fancy igniting their campaigns this week. 
--> Those sitting pretty toward the summit have the luxury of relaxing at this relatively early juncture, and although we’re still almost three months away from the chaotic Matchday 8, those bereft of points as we approach halfway will certainly fancy igniting their campaigns this week. 
 We’re looking at you, Porto.

 AEK Athens vs. Real Madrid Prediction
--> AEK Athens vs. Real Madrid Prediction
 Real Madrid have found their groove. | Federico Titone/SOPA Images/LightRocket/Getty Images Prediction: AEK Athens 1–3 Real Madrid 
--> Prediction: AEK Athens 1–3 Real Madrid 
 Location: Athens, Greece
 Stadium: Agia Sophia Stadium
 Date: Wednesday, Nov. 4
 Kick-off Time: 5:45 p.m. GMT / 12:45 p.m. ET / 9:45 a.m. PT
 Referee: Maurizio Mariani (ITA)
 --> Location: Athens, Greece
 Stadium: Agia Sophia Stadium
 Date: Wednesday, Nov. 4
 Kick-off Time: 5:45 p.m. GMT / 12:45 p.m. ET / 9:45 a.m. PT
 Referee: Maurizio Mariani (ITA)
 The 15-time champions are in a good moment, and surely not even the return of Vínicius Júnior can crush their momentum.
--> The 15-time champions are in a good moment, and surely not even the return of Vínicius Júnior can crush their momentum.
 Real Madrid followed their impressive victory in El Clásico with an emphatic win at Racing Santander to keep pace with Barcelona and Atlético Madrid, who both won on Saturday.
--> Real Madrid followed their impressive victory in El Clásico with an emphatic win at Racing Santander to keep pace with Barcelona and Atlético Madrid, who both won on Saturday.
 They’re now heading to the Greek capital aiming to maintain their 100% start to the league phase, having so far defeated two of Mourinho’s former clubs, Inter Milan and Roma, as well as RB Leipzig. 
--> They’re now heading to the Greek capital aiming to maintain their 100% start to the league phase, having so far defeated two of Mourinho’s former clubs, Inter Milan and Roma, as well as RB Leipzig. 
 AEK Athens were thumped at Manchester City on Matchday 3, but they do have three points on the board thanks to their opening matchday triumph over LASK. 
--> AEK Athens were thumped at Manchester City on Matchday 3, but they do have three points on the board thanks to their opening matchday triumph over LASK. 
 Luka Jović is likely to be in a vengeful mood here against his former employers. 
--> Luka Jović is likely to be in a vengeful mood here against his former employers. 
 Fenerbahçe vs. Liverpool Prediction
--> Fenerbahçe vs. Liverpool Prediction
 Liverpool have a bad record in Türkiye. | Liverpool FC/Getty Images Prediction: Fenerbahçe 1–2 Liverpool 
--> Prediction: Fenerbahçe 1–2 Liverpool 
 Location: Istanbul, Türkiye
 Stadium: Chobani Stadium
 Date: Wednesday, Nov. 4
 Kick-off Time: 5:45 p.m. GMT / 12:45 p.m. ET / 9:45 a.m. PT
 Referee: Clément Turpin (FRA)
 --> Location: Istanbul, Türkiye
 Stadium: Chobani Stadium
 Date: Wednesday, Nov. 4
 Kick-off Time: 5:45 p.m. GMT / 12:45 p.m. ET / 9:45 a.m. PT
 Referee: Clément Turpin (FRA)
 Liverpool haven’t enjoyed their trips to Türkiye over the years, and they were twice beaten 1–0 by Fenerbahçe’s fiercest rivals, Galatasaray, last season. 
--> Liverpool haven’t enjoyed their trips to Türkiye over the years, and they were twice beaten 1–0 by Fenerbahçe’s fiercest rivals, Galatasaray, last season. 
 They’re heading seven miles away from RAMS Park this time around, taking on an out-of-form Fenerbahçe side led by former Anfield cult hero Dirk Kuyt. The Dutchman has stepped up to mitigate İsmail Kartal’s resignation, which he threatened after the 1–1 draw with Roma on Matchday 1. 
--> They’re heading seven miles away from RAMS Park this time around, taking on an out-of-form Fenerbahçe side led by former Anfield cult hero Dirk Kuyt. The Dutchman has stepped up to mitigate İsmail Kartal’s resignation, which he threatened after the 1–1 draw with Roma on Matchday 1. 
 The hosts are struggling domestically despite their litany of stars and have yet to taste victory upon their return to this competition. 
--> The hosts are struggling domestically despite their litany of stars and have yet to taste victory upon their return to this competition. 
 Liverpool’s woes in this part of the world should embolden Kuyt’s side, but Andoni Iraola‘s visitors have made an impressive start to their continental campaign, and there were more encouraging signs even in defeat against Arsenal at the weekend. 
--> Liverpool’s woes in this part of the world should embolden Kuyt’s side, but Andoni Iraola‘s visitors have made an impressive start to their continental campaign, and there were more encouraging signs even in defeat against Arsenal at the weekend. 
 Borussia Dortmund vs. Real Betis Prediction
--> Borussia Dortmund vs. Real Betis Prediction

--> Prediction: Borussia Dortmund 2–1 Real Betis 
 Location: Dortmund, Germany
 Stadium: Signal Iduna Park
 Date: Wednesday, Nov. 4

 --> Location: Dortmund, Germany

 Real Betis have waited two decades to mingle with the elite, and they’re certainly making up for lost time. 
--> Real Betis have waited two decades to mingle with the elite, and they’re certainly making up for lost time. 
 While Manuel Pellegrini’s team hasn’t yet topped a giant, it has notched three impressive victories against Lille, Porto and Feyenoord to sit well inside the top eight after three games. 
--> While Manuel Pellegrini’s team hasn’t yet topped a giant, it has notched three impressive victories against Lille, Porto and Feyenoord to sit well inside the top eight after three games. 
 However, this is undoubtedly their toughest test to date. Trips to Signal Iduna Park are never for the faint-hearted, and Borussia Dortmund enter this clash off the back of snatching a late equalizer in Der Klassiker on Saturday. 
--> However, this is undoubtedly their toughest test to date. Trips to Signal Iduna Park are never for the faint-hearted, and Borussia Dortmund enter this clash off the back of snatching a late equalizer in Der Klassiker on Saturday. 
 The Yellow Wall will be humming under the lights.

 Lens vs. Como Prediction
--> Lens vs. Como Prediction
 Prediction: Lens 2–3 Como 
--> Prediction: Lens 2–3 Como 
 Location: Lens, France
 Stadium: Stade Bollaert-Delelis
 Date: Wednesday, Nov. 4
 Kick-off Time: 8 p.m. GMT / 3 p.m. ET / 12 p.m. PT
 Referee: Rohit Saggi (NOR)
 --> Location: Lens, France
 Stadium: Stade Bollaert-Delelis
 Date: Wednesday, Nov. 4
 Kick-off Time: 8 p.m. GMT / 3 p.m. ET / 12 p.m. PT
 Referee: Rohit Saggi (NOR)
 Hey, let’s not write off Como in the Serie A title discussion. It wouldn’t be a surprise if Cesc Fàbregas got his hands on the Scudetto next May, given the speed at which his team continues to develop. 
--> Hey, let’s not write off Como in the Serie A title discussion. It wouldn’t be a surprise if Cesc Fàbregas got his hands on the Scudetto next May, given the speed at which his team continues to develop. 
 They’ve won four on the bounce domestically, and responded to their defeat at Feyenoord on Matchday 2 by having their way with a wretched Manchester United team. They’ve won both of their home games in the league phase 4–1, but they’ll have to grind out victories on their travels if they’re to enjoy a deep run in this competition. 
--> They’ve won four on the bounce domestically, and responded to their defeat at Feyenoord on Matchday 2 by having their way with a wretched Manchester United team. They’ve won both of their home games in the league phase 4–1, but they’ll have to grind out victories on their travels if they’re to enjoy a deep run in this competition. 
 A trip to Lens is unlikely to be as daunting as their De Kuip excursion, but you’d be foolish to completely write the hosts off. It’s a fairly tumultuous time for the French club, with Florian Thauvin’s magic supplying a much-needed sense of familiarity.
--> A trip to Lens is unlikely to be as daunting as their De Kuip excursion, but you’d be foolish to completely write the hosts off. It’s a fairly tumultuous time for the French club, with Florian Thauvin’s magic supplying a much-needed sense of familiarity.
 Thauvin leads all players in this season’s Champions League with 15 chances created. 
--> Thauvin leads all players in this season’s Champions League with 15 chances created.

 --> Location: Porto, Portugal
 Stadium: Estádio do Dragão

 Massimiliano Allegri was on the brink not so long ago, but Napoli’s form has just about steadied both in Europe and on the domestic front.
--> Massimiliano Allegri was on the brink not so long ago, but Napoli’s form has just about steadied both in Europe and on the domestic front.
 Allegri’s soccer still leaves plenty to be desired, though, and he endured an unsuccessful return to Turin at the weekend, with Napoli falling to a 2–0 defeat at Juventus. 
--> Allegri’s soccer still leaves plenty to be desired, though, and he endured an unsuccessful return to Turin at the weekend, with Napoli falling to a 2–0 defeat at Juventus. 
 They’re currently destined for Serie A mediocrity, and potentially a premature exit on the continent. Napoli have three points to their name by virtue of an entertaining victory over Bodø/Glimt last time out, and now Allegri’s side are facing a desperate Porto team.
--> They’re currently destined for Serie A mediocrity, and potentially a premature exit on the continent. Napoli have three points to their name by virtue of an entertaining victory over Bodø/Glimt last time out, and now Allegri’s side are facing a desperate Porto team.
 The hosts have been dominant in the Primeira Liga, but are one of just two teams yet to notch a single point in the league phase. 
--> The hosts have been dominant in the Primeira Liga, but are one of just two teams yet to notch a single point in the league phase. 
 PSV Eindhoven vs. Club Brugge Prediction
--> PSV Eindhoven vs. Club Brugge Prediction

--> Prediction: PSV 2–2 Club Brugge 
 Location: Eindhoven, Netherlands
 Stadium: Philips Stadion
 Date: Wednesday, Nov. 4

 Referee: Irfan Peljto (BIH)
 Peter Bosz would‘ve felt his side missed an opportunity to take Eredivisie leaders Feyenoord down a peg or two when the two teams met 10 days ago, but the recent monopolizers of Dutch soccer failed to build on their early lead and handed the league‘s pace setters a route back into the contest. 
--> Peter Bosz would‘ve felt his side missed an opportunity to take Eredivisie leaders Feyenoord down a peg or two when the two teams met 10 days ago, but the recent monopolizers of Dutch soccer failed to build on their early lead and handed the league‘s pace setters a route back into the contest. 
 A 1–1 draw suited Feyenoord a whole lot more, and PSV blew off some steam at the weekend, thrashing Willem II 7–0 with seven different players getting on the scoresheet. 
--> A 1–1 draw suited Feyenoord a whole lot more, and PSV blew off some steam at the weekend, thrashing Willem II 7–0 with seven different players getting on the scoresheet. 
 Their start in the Champions League has been respectable enough, and they’ll be pleased to return to the Philips Stadion on Matchday 4. However, Club Brugge are emerging as a hipster’s dream, with the Belgians continuing to ruffle the feathers of the continent’s elite.

--> RB Leipzig vs. Manchester City Prediction
 These two teams meet for the seventh time since 2021. | Ryan Pierse/UEFA/Getty Images Prediction: Leipzig 2–3 Man City 
--> Prediction: Leipzig 2–3 Man City 
 Location: Leipzig, Germany

 --> Location: Leipzig, Germany

 Former Manchester City defender Martín Demichelis will parade the home dugout in Leipzig on Wednesday, as the hosts aim to secure a statement victory on Matchday 4. 
--> Former Manchester City defender Martín Demichelis will parade the home dugout in Leipzig on Wednesday, as the hosts aim to secure a statement victory on Matchday 4. 
 RB Leipzig have been tremendous at home this season, winning their four games in the Bundesliga by an 18–0 aggregate score. They also beat PSV at the Red Bull Arena on Matchday 2, but were emphatically defeated at Como and Real Madrid on either side. 
--> RB Leipzig have been tremendous at home this season, winning their four games in the Bundesliga by an 18–0 aggregate score. They also beat PSV at the Red Bull Arena on Matchday 2, but were emphatically defeated at Como and Real Madrid on either side. 
 Still, Demichelis‘s team has the tools to hurt a defensively frail Man City side reeling off the back of consecutive league defeats. Antonio Nusa has 10 Bundesliga goal contributions already, but it‘s the winger’s compatriot, Erling Haaland, who’s the most likely to take this game over.
--> Still, Demichelis‘s team has the tools to hurt a defensively frail Man City side reeling off the back of consecutive league defeats. Antonio Nusa has 10 Bundesliga goal contributions already, but it‘s the winger’s compatriot, Erling Haaland, who’s the most likely to take this game over.
 Haaland has scored more goals against Leipzig (12) than any other opponent in his career.

 Arsenal travel to Prague for the second consecutive year, having won 3–0 at the Eden Arena last November.
--> Arsenal travel to Prague for the second consecutive year, having won 3–0 at the Eden Arena last November.

 Of course, this fixture can’t go the distance, but Slavia would bite your hand off for a point right now.

 The debutants take on the novices.

 First-timers Sabah claimed their maiden victory in this competition on Matchday 2, beating Slavia Prague, while Viking, who last featured in the Champions League in 1992–93, are still waiting to celebrate such an achievement.
--> First-timers Sabah claimed their maiden victory in this competition on Matchday 2, beating Slavia Prague, while Viking, who last featured in the Champions League in 1992–93, are still waiting to celebrate such an achievement.
